newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks plunge 3.83 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks plunge 3.83 pct in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan stocks tumbled 3.83 percent shortly before Monday's close as jitters over deeply unsettled domestic politics intensified selling, brokers said.
With 15 minutes to go, at 0345 GMT, the index had lost 316.94 points to dip below the 8,000 mark, falling to 7,957.25 points. Turnover was a heavy T$134 billion.
Brokers said long-standing technical support for the index appeared to have collapsed.
"People are panicked," said Wang Jieh, an analyst at Foremost Investment. "They have no confidence in the government and sentiment is extremely weak."
The late slide accelerated despite market rumours that some government-related funds would intervene to support the market and stave off further falls. brokers said.
Plastics and construction shares were hardest hit, down 5.05 percent and 5.19 percent, respectively.
